rows.text: Every Aura you CAST pulls a second one out of your library for free. Light-Paws searches for an Aura with mana value no greater than the one you cast and a name you don't already have, and puts it straight onto her. So a two-mana Aura is really two Auras, and a four-mana one can fetch the best four-drop in the deck. Stack protection first, then damage, then swing with a commander nobody can touch.

rows.name: Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice
rows.text: two mana. Whenever an Aura you control enters, if you CAST it, search for an Aura with mana value less than or equal to it and a different name from every Aura you control, and put it onto the battlefield attached to Light-Paws. The fetched Aura was not cast, so it does not trigger her again: one cast, one fetch.

The cast Aura can go anywhere. Cast Reprobation on an opponent's creature and the fetch still lands on Light-Paws. But the FETCHED Aura always goes on her, so never fetch Reprobation, Darksteel Mutation or Swift Reconfiguration: they would shut her off. On Thin Ice cannot be fetched at all; it can only enchant a snow land.
Benevolent Blessing and Flickering Ward give protection from a colour you choose. Never choose white: protection from white stops your own new Auras attaching to her.

guide.title: Aura chains — what to cast, and what it fetches

rows.text: Cast the most expensive Aura you can, because it sets the ceiling on the fetch.

rows.name: Angelic Destiny -> Sage's Reverie
rows.text: four into four. Destiny makes her a 6/6 flying first-striker, then Reverie draws a card for every Aura on a creature and pumps her again. With three or more Auras out, this is the best card-draw turn in the deck.

rows.name: Sage's Reverie -> Angelic Destiny
rows.text: the same pair the other way round, when Reverie is the one in hand.

rows.name: Battle Mastery -> Chains of Custody
rows.text: double strike now, and the fetched Chains exiles an opponent's best nonland permanent until it leaves. Removal without spending a card.

rows.name: Chains of Custody -> Battle Mastery
rows.text: cast Chains for the removal, fetch double strike onto her.

rows.name: Twinblade Blessing -> Timely Ward
rows.text: Twinblade has flash, so cast it in their end step or mid-combat, and fetch indestructible in response to nothing at all.

rows.name: Mantle of the Ancients -> Angelic Destiny
rows.text: Mantle returns every Aura and Equipment from your graveyard onto her, then fetches a four-drop. The rebuild after a wipe.

rows.name: Reprobation -> Ethereal Armor
rows.text: cast the removal Aura on THEIR creature; the fetch still goes on Light-Paws.

rows.name: Ethereal Armor -> Hyena Umbra
rows.text: the turn-two chain. First strike, plus umbra armor so the first removal spell misses.

rows.name: Battle Mastery
rows.text: double strike. Every pump after this counts twice.

rows.name: Twinblade Blessing
rows.text: double strike with flash: the surprise version.

rows.name: Ethereal Armor
rows.text: +1/+1 for each enchantment you control, and first strike. With six Auras out it is +6/+6 on its own.

rows.name: All That Glitters
rows.text: +1/+1 for each artifact and enchantment you control.

rows.name: Daybreak Coronet
rows.text: needs another Aura already on her: +3/+3, first strike, vigilance and lifelink.

rows.name: Idolized
rows.text: when she attacks alone, +X/+X where X is your nonland permanents.

rows.name: Angelic Destiny
rows.text: +4/+4, flying and first strike, and it returns to your hand if she dies.

rows.name: Kor Spiritdancer
rows.text: the backup body: +2/+2 per Aura on IT, and a card every time you cast an Aura.

rows.name: Stoneskin + Solid Footing + Triclopean Sight
rows.text: Stoneskin gives +0/+10, Triclopean Sight gives vigilance, and Solid Footing makes a vigilant creature deal combat damage equal to its TOUGHNESS. With all three she is a 4/14 that hits for 14, or 28 with double strike.

rows.name: Rogue's Passage
rows.text: {4}, {T}: she can't be blocked this turn.

rows.name: Skrelv, Defector Mite
rows.text: gives her toxic 1 and makes her unblockable by a chosen colour; each hit is also poison.

rows.name: Mother of Runes
rows.text: protection from a colour at instant speed. Pick a colour that is NOT white if she is the target, or her Auras fall off.

rows.name: Giver of Runes
rows.text: the same, from colourless too.

rows.name: Swiftfoot Boots
rows.text: hexproof stops opponents only, so your own Auras still attach.

rows.name: Brilliant Wings
rows.text: flash, flying and hexproof.

rows.name: Shardmage's Rescue
rows.text: flash hexproof for the turn it enters. Cast it in response to removal; the fetch is a second Aura on top.

rows.name: Timely Ward
rows.text: indestructible, castable at instant speed because it targets your commander.

rows.name: Spirit Mantle
rows.text: protection from creatures: unblockable by creatures and immune to their abilities.

rows.name: Unquestioned Authority
rows.text: protection from creatures, and it draws a card.

rows.name: Mask of Law and Grace
rows.text: protection from black and red.

rows.name: Shield of Duty and Reason
rows.text: protection from green and blue.

rows.name: Benevolent Blessing
rows.text: flash protection from the chosen colour, never white.

rows.name: Flickering Ward
rows.text: protection from a colour, and {W} returns it to hand to recast for another fetch.

rows.name: Hyena Umbra
rows.text: umbra armor: the first destroy effect removes the Umbra instead of her.

rows.name: Loran's Escape
rows.text: one mana, hexproof and indestructible for the turn.

rows.name: Rebuff the Wicked
rows.text: counters a spell that targets your permanent.

rows.name: Galadriel's Dismissal
rows.text: phase her out in response to removal, or kick it to phase out a blocker's whole board.

rows.name: Teferi's Protection
rows.text: the reset button. Everything phases out, Auras included, and comes back attached.

rows.name: Plaza of Heroes
rows.text: exile it for hexproof and indestructible on her.

rows.name: Eiganjo Castle
rows.text: prevents 2 damage to a legendary creature each turn.

rows.name: Pariah
rows.text: all damage to you is dealt to her instead. On a Light-Paws with Stoneskin or Timely Ward, nobody can hurt you.

guide.title: Removal that is also an Aura

rows.text: Every one of these is a cast Aura, so each also fetches something onto Light-Paws.

rows.name: Chains of Custody
rows.text: exiles a nonland permanent until Chains leaves, and gives her ward {2}.

rows.name: Sheltered by Ghosts
rows.text: the same exile, plus lifelink and ward {2}.

rows.name: Reprobation
rows.text: their creature becomes a 0/1 with no abilities.

rows.name: Darksteel Mutation
rows.text: their creature becomes a 0/1 indestructible artifact with no abilities: good against creatures that come back.

rows.name: Swift Reconfiguration
rows.text: turns a creature into a Vehicle that needs crew 5. Flash.

rows.name: On Thin Ice
rows.text: exiles a creature. It enchants one of your snow lands, which is why the basics are Snow-Covered Plains.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares
rows.text: one mana, exile a creature.

rows.name: Path to Exile
rows.text: the same, for a basic land.

rows.name: Mesa Enchantress

rows.name: Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor

rows.name: Esper Sentinel
rows.text: taxes their first noncreature spell each turn.

rows.name: Feather of Flight
rows.text: flash flying, and draws a card.

rows.name: Serra's Sanctum
rows.text: taps for {W} per enchantment you control. With five Auras out it is five mana from a land.

rows.name: Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
rows.text: {2}, {T}: white mana equal to your devotion. Every Aura's {W} counts.

rows.name: Land Tax
rows.text: three basics a turn when an opponent has more lands.

rows.name: Archaeomancer's Map
rows.text: two Plains to hand, then lands when opponents get ahead.

rows.name: Pearl Medallion
rows.text: white spells cost {1} less.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: the usual.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: the usual.

rows.name: Mind Stone
rows.text: a rock that cashes in for a card later.

rows.text: a free white for a turn-one Light-Paws.

rows.text: taps for white once Light-Paws or another legend is out.

rows.text: chapter III fetches Sol Ring, Mox Amber or Lotus Petal.

rows.name: Grand Abolisher
rows.text: on your turn nobody can respond to the attack or the Aura chain.

rows.name: Silence
rows.text: the one-turn version, cast before the big chain.

rows.name: Archon of Emeria
rows.text: one spell per turn for everyone. Light-Paws is the least affected: one Aura a turn is still two.

rows.name: Aven Mindcensor
rows.text: their searches only see the top four cards.

rows.text: stops creature enter and death triggers. Your Auras' triggers are not creatures, so they still work.

rows.name: Replenish
rows.text: every enchantment in your graveyard returns at once. Auras that can't attach to anything stay behind.

rows.text: every Aura in your graveyard returns attached to creatures.

rows.text: returns Auras and Equipment onto the creature it enchants.

rows.text: puts an enchantment from your graveyard on top of your library.

rows.name: Gryff's Boon
rows.text: comes back from the graveyard for {3}{W}.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.name: Open the Armory -> Battle Mastery
rows.text: any Aura to hand. Take Battle Mastery when she is already protected, a protection Aura when she is not.

rows.name: Enlightened Tutor -> Angelic Destiny
rows.text: puts any enchantment on top of your library. Take the biggest Aura you can cast next turn, because it fetches the biggest second Aura.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep Light-Paws mana, one cheap Aura and one way to protect her. A hand of four-mana Auras with no early play is a mulligan.
Turn two Light-Paws, turn three cast a one-mana Aura to fetch Hyena Umbra or Shardmage's Rescue, then a damage Aura. Protection first, then damage.
Before the big chain, play Grand Abolisher or Silence so nobody can respond.
If she dies, Angelic Destiny comes back to your hand and Mantle of the Ancients or Retether rebuild the stack in one card.
